current: CORS preflight for `POST /api/v1/auth/login` answered **405 Method Not Allowed** instead of 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods
target: a preflight answers 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Origin, -Methods and -Headers
delta: a browser refuses to send the real request, so every cross-origin write from the web app fails; curl and the in-process ASGI test client both pass, which is why this was never caught
fix: intercept OPTIONS before routing — use Starlette's CORSMiddleware at app level instead of adding the headers in a BaseHTTPMiddleware, which runs after routing has already 405'd
snippet: allow_origin=['http://localhost:3000'] allow_methods=['GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS']
